tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyud don thams cad dril nas nyams len tshul/

/gsal bar ston pa'i sgrub thabs rdo rje 'bar/ /rje btsun rdo rje 'jigs byed mnyes byed 'di/ /bris tshe cho 'phrul rnam 'gyur ci yang byung*/ /shubhaṃ/ oṃ na mo mañdzu badz+re bh+yāḥ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sgrub thabs rdo rje 'bar ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i rdo rje rab tu khros pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'jam pa'i rdo rje rang bzhin lhan cig skyes/ /kun tu rtog la rab khros bhai ra ba/ /dpal ldan bla ma rang rig bde ye shes/ /'pho ba'i mthar byed 'joms la rab tu 'dud/ /brtags bral las kyang brtags pa'i cho 'phrul ni/ /rtag tu shar yang 'char nub kun bral ba/ /sgyu ma'i rdo rje cir yang snang ba po/ /rdo rje khro bos bdud kyi dkyil 'khor choms/ /dang po'i las can dag gi rnal 'byor la/ /shin tu goms pa rnams la'ang yid bzhin gter/ /brjod bral 'dir ni brjod par shar ba las/ /gdod ma'i dpa' bo bskul ba'i tshul 'di mtshar/ /'dir 'jam pa'i rdo rje dpal 'jigs mdzad chen po sgrub par 'dod pa'i las dang po pas dur khrod la sogs par gsang ba'i bris sku dgram zhing*/ mchod pa dang gtor ma dag dam tshig dang rjes su mthun par bshams/ sngags pa kha lhor phyogs pas bdud rtsis kha dag pa dang*/ bar gcod bsrung ba'i don du phyogs skyong gi gtor ma sogs 'grub na bya zhing*/ rang nyid ro gdan la 'dug par bsam la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdor sems kyi sgom bzlas bya/ skad cig gis rang rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi snying gar pad nyi la hūṃ nag po mchog tu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis/ bla ma mi bskyod pas gtso bo'i cod pan du byas pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drang badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yāḥ na mo badz+ra bhai ra ba maṇ+ḍal bh+yāḥ rnam rtog dra ba rab bsal zhing*/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i thugs mnga' ba/ /'jam dpal khro bo'i dkyil 'khor pa/

/rdo rje 'dzin bcas phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mā le traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra girti hṝḥ oṃ badz+ra nirti āḥ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe traṃ/ oṃ badz+rā a lo ke hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs dang*/ tshad med bzhi sgom pa spyi ltar bya/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dha sar+b+ba dharma swa bhā ba shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ shu n+yā ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wāt+ma ko3haṃ/ bdag dang lha dang chos thams cad spros med 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bur bsam la 'chi ba sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ/ de las 'od 'phros rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa gur stug po bla bre phyi rol rdo rje'i mes gtams pa/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ de'i dbus su e las chos 'byung dkar po kha gyen bstan gyi nang du dur khrod chen po 'jigs su rung zhing skyi g.ya' ba brgyad kyis bskor ba ste/ de dag na shing dang phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong dang chu dang me dang klu dang sprin dang mchod rten brgyad brgyad dang bcas pa/ ma mo srin po sha za gshin rje ro langs la sogs pa 'byung po'i tshogs lang long du rgyu zhing ha ha'i sgra dang*/ ku co brag cha dang bcas pa lhang lhang bor 'bod pa/ mdung la skyon pa/ shing la dpyangs pa/ mes tshig pa la sogs pa'i ro sna tshogs dang*/ keng rus dang ro mgo med gar byed cing*/ rus pa dang khrag dang sha dang klad pa 'thor ba dang*/ dum bus khebs pa/ bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs 'thab pa dang 'khrug pa nga ro 'don pa/ 'byung po rnams kyi spyod pa sna tshogs pas yid sgyur bar byed pa/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang sgrub pa po dang grub pa'i rig 'dzin rnams dam tshig gis spyod pa dang*/ 'jigs pa med pa thod rnga'i sgra dang bcas gar byed pa dang*/ mchod rdzas sna tshogs pas gang ba'i dbus na/

yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba'i kha dog can gyi steng du pad nyi'i gdan la/ a las zla ba gang ba la gnas pa'i dhīḥyongs su gyur pa las/ dri za dang rjes su mthun par rlung sems phra mo'i snang ba 'jam dpal gzhon nu gur kum gzhon nu'i me tog rgyas pa ltar dmar ser/ phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar stabs/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pas ut+pal sngon po kha bye ba la gnas pa'i po ti bsnams pa/ zhi zhing sgeg pa/ rgyan thams cad dang mtshan dpe rdzogs pa/ brgyad gnyis lon pa'i na tshod can/ bung ba ltar gnag pa'i dbu skra'i thor tshugs las 'phyang ba'i zur phud lnga sil le bun ne bas mdzes pa/ rdo rje gdan gyis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar a las bdun pa'i bdag pos las saṃ/ de la gnas pa'i hūṃ las 'od 'phrosas pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa/ sems dpa' rig ma khro bo la sogs pa spyan drangs pa/ sems can skye ba dang chos mthun par 'jam dpal zla ba dang bcas pa/ de thams cad nyi ma la thim pas tsha zer 'bar ba/ dpag tshad 'bum du khyab pa/ yang de'i 'od zer gyis sngags 'phreng rnams spyan drangs te bstim pas/ hūṃ nag po 'od zer lnga ldan du gyur/ yang na/ 'bum du khyab pa'i steng du hūṃ nag po zhes sogs bya/ de'i 'od kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa phyag mtshan gyi rnam par spyan drangs te thims pas/ hūṃ de nyid rdo rje chen po mthing nag rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa/ 'od lnga 'bar ba/ de las de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa dang*/ rdo rje phra mo mtha' yas pa spros/ sdang ba dang gdug pa rnams tshar gcad/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la bkod/ zhing khams dag par byas/ de rnams dang 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor tshad med pa spyan drangs te/ de dag thams cad gcig tu gyur pa las/ bdag nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed dus mtha'i sprin dang mun pa ltar gnag cing ngam za ba/

zhal dgu'i rtsa zhal mthing nag ma he nag po shin tu khros pa'i gdong*/ rwa sngo bsangs shin tu rno zhing*/ rdo rje'i me lce lhab lhab 'bar bas phyogs thams cad gnon pa/ rwa'i g.yas zhal gsum mdun nas rim pas sngon po dmar po ser po ste shin tu khros pa/ rwa'i g.yon gyi zhal gsum mdun nas rim pas dkar po dud kha nag po ste dpa' zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ rwa gnyis kyi dbus su steng zhal dmar po zhal nas khrag 'dzag pa/ srin po ltar ches 'jigs shing ha ha pheṃ zhes drag tu bzhad pa/ de'i steng du 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i zhal ser mdog yid tsam khro zhing 'dzum pa zur phud lnga ldan byis pa'i rgyan bzang pos spras pa/ zhal thams cad spyan gsum pa/ khro zhal thams cad rdo rje gad mo drag tu rgod cing*/ hūṃ phaṭa kyi sgra gnam du 'bod pa/ dgra bgegs kyi sha dang rkang dang tshil za ba/ rnam par 'gyur ba'i zhal/ khro gnyer bsdus pa'i 'gram nas 'bar ba'i smin ma 'khyog por bcus shing*/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum sdang mig tu lta zhing zlog pa/ skra ser po gyen du 'bar pa me stag lta bu'i smin rdzi dang*/ sma ra dang ba spu can/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha thams cad sdigs mdzub kyis bsdigs pa/ mi bzad pa'i zhal mche ba bzhi bzhi dang bcas pa/ ljags 'gril ba/ 'jigs pa chen po dus kyi rlung dang 'brug stong ldir ba lta bu'i mtshams rngam gyi sgra'i gad rgyangs kyis bdud sde'i snying 'gas pa/ langs tsho la bab pa sku lus che zhing rags pa'i yan lag dang nying lag /spom thung hrags shing mkhreng bag can/ sgyu 'phrul rdo rje gsus po che/ rab tu rgyas pa'i liṅga gyen du bsgreng ba/ phyag sum cu rtsa bzhi'i dang po gnyis rdo rje gri gug dang thod khrag bag tsam rdeg thabs kyi thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yas lhag mas rim bzhin bi dhi pa la/ brtun shing*/ chu gri/ ka na ya/ sta re/ mdung rings/

mda'/ lcags kyu/ dbyug pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga/'khor lo/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ tho ba/ ral gri/ rnge'u chung rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon rnams kyi tshangs mgo /phub/ rkang pa/ zhags pa/ gzhu/ rgyu ma/ dril bu/ lag pa/ ro ras/ skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa/ me thab/ thod tshal gyi kha phor bdud rtsis gang ba/ sdigs mdzub/ 'phan rtse gsum pa/ rlung gis bskyod pa'i ras rnams bsnams pa/ tha ma gnyis kyi glang po che'i lpags rlon khrag 'dzag pa stod g.yogs su byas pa'o/ /zhabs bcu drug g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i gyad chen po'i stobs kyis srid pa gsum g.yo zhing 'dar bar byed cing lhag par brjid pa'i stabs kyi bzhugs pa'i g.yas brgyad kyis/ mi/ ma he/ glang*/ bong bu/ rnga mo/ khyi/ lug/wa rnams dang*/ g.yon brgyad kyis bya rgod/ 'ug pa/ khwa/ ne tso/ bong khra/ bya chen po/ ri skeg/bzhad rnams gnod pa/ de rnams kyi 'og tu tshangs pa/ dbang po/ khyab 'jug/drag po ste bdud bzhi dang*/ tshogs kyi bdag po/ karti ka /nyi ma/ zla ba rnams kha sbub tu bsgyel nas mnan pa/ gcer bu shin tu gtum pa/ 'jigs su rung ba'i thod skam lnga lngas dbu brgyan pa/ mi mgo khrag 'dzag pa brgya phyed rgyu rlon la brgyus pa'i do shal dang*/ klu brgyad dang*/ gdug pa'i sbrul nag po'i mchod phyir thogs dang rus pa'i rgyan drug dang khrag dang zhag dang thal chen gyis spras pa/ sprul pa'i pho nya dpag tu med pa spro ba/ 'jig dus kyi me ltar drag tu 'bar zhing 'khrug pa'i me dpung gi klong na bzhugs pa lta bar yang mi bzod pa'i bdag nyid du gyur/ oṃ swa bhā sogs brjod de bsnyen pa'o/ / mig tu k+ṣiṃ dkar po sa snying*/ rna bar dz+riṃ sngon po phyag rdor/ snar khaṃ ser po nam snying*/ lcer gaṃ dmar po 'jig rten dbang phyug /dpral bar skaṃ ljang khu sgrib sel/ lte bar saṃ dkar po kun bzang gi ngo bo ste/ nyer sgrub bo/ / dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/

thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin hūṃ gi 'od zer mkha' dbyings thams cad du son/ chos kyi dbyings las gdug pa ma lus pa 'dul ba'i phyir rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes kyi sku/ 'jam dpal khros pa'i dkyil 'khor sad pa la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras bcas kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ yang na/ oṃ hrīḥha bho mahā kro dha ā gats+tsha a gats+tsha asmat+ta pū dza pra ti gṛh+ṇan+tu pra sā dha me dhī man+ku ru swāhā/ hrīḥṣ+tīḥ sa phyi 'brangs gyis bgegs bskrad/ lā s+ya sogs sngar bzhin nam/ hrīḥṣ+tīḥha sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ de ni sgrub pa'o/ / dbang gi lha rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sngar bzhin mchod/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /skye bas thob pa dbang bskur bas/ /ji ltar de bzhin bdag gis te/ /dag pa lha yi chu dbang bskur/ /oṃ badz+ro da kā bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ rdo rje'i khro bo'i mthu stobs dang 'phrin las thams cad la dbang ba byas/ chu'i dwangs ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dzaḥhūṃ sogs kyis thim/ yang na gong gi dza hūṃ nas sngar bzhin mchod zhes pa'i bar dor ba yang man ngag gi lugs gzhan no/ /rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya gnas gsum du gtugs hrīḥṣ+tīḥ gsum brjod/ rang gi snying gar ye shes sems dpa' 'jam dpal gyi thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ yig mar me ltar 'bar ba rtag tu 'char bzhin pa ste/ sgrub pa chen po'o/ /sems dpa' gsum brtseg 'di gtso bo bskyed ma thag tu byed pa'ang lugs gzhan no/ / ar+ghaṃ sogs sngar bzhin mchod/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā bāt+ma ko3haṃ/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/

zhes myangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra swa bhā bāt+ma ko3haṃ/ thugs ka nas yid kyi rig ma mā ma kī spros/ snyoms par zhugs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā gā na badz+ra swa bhā ba at+ma ko3haṃ/ dur khrod rgyan gyis legs brgyan pa'i/ / sogs kyi bstod pa bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti ra badz+ra swa bhā bāt+ma ko3haṃ/ de nas man ngag ltar/ snying gar rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma sngags 'phreng ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rnams bkod la/ oṃ ya ma rā dzā sa do me ya ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya ya k+ṣe yats+tsha ni rā ma ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tīḥbi kṛ tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ya mān+ta hūṃ phaṭa/ ci nus pa de srid du g.yeng ba med pas bzla'o/ /'di la ci rigs par oṃ a ra tsa na dhīḥ bzla ba'ang snang ngo*/ /bar bar du lha'i sku la rtse gcig tu yid bzhag ces/ de yang spangs rtogs kyi yon tan re re nas dran par byas te thams cad dang ldan pa'i/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes 'jam dpal khros pa gshin rje gshed skyon kun spangs yon tan kun ldan dngos te nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal dang*/ gsal snang la spyod tshul yang*/ thog mar spyi rags pa de la yang yang sgrim/ gsal dwangs rnyog pa med pa'i ma he'i zhal/ zhal dgu/ phyag so bzhi/ zhabs bcu drug pa/ snod thams cad 'od kyi gzhal yas khang*/ zhes brjod cing yang yang bsams/ der rags pa'i rnam pa la cung zad brtan pa na/ phra mo nas gsal gdab ste/ ma he'i gdong mthing nag spyan gsum khra zlum zlum pa/ 'od dmar po bskal pa'i me 'bar ba lta bu zhes dang*/ rwa sngo bsangs rtsa ba khrom gnyer can/ bar 'ja' khugs rtse mo rno zul zul ba zhes dang*/ steng zhal dmar lam lam pa/ dmar tsher tsher ba nyi ma 'bum shar ba lta bu ha ha zhes drag tu bzhad pa zhes dang*/ 'jam dpal gyi zhal dmar ser smin pa nag khyug khyug pa/ spyan dkyus ring zhing bkra ba/ shangs gzengs mtho pa/

mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa/ zhes sogs cha phra mo nas brjod cing gsal btab/ ces de nyid rig pa kha cig 'doms par mdzad do/ /ye shes kyi rig ma la sogs pa'i zhu bde dang*/ lha'i nga rgyal dang dkyil 'khor gyi gsal snang dang*/ de thams cad dang rang bzhin med pa la rnam par mi rtog pas 'jug pa ste/ 'di ni rnal 'byor chen po'i lha'i rnal 'byor spyi'i gnad dam pa'o/ /de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa yar sgom ste phyis bshad par bya'o/ / rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor/ de thams cad rang la thim/ bsrung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang zhes sam/ gzhal yang khang ma bskyed na bcas pa rang la thim/ rang gi zhal phyag lhag ma'ang rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la bsdu/ rang phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal bya/ mig tu k+ṣiṃ sogs dang*/ dpral bar oṃ sogs bya/ dge ba bsngo/ gal te lha dgu sgom par 'dod na/ yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ las 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du chos 'byung dkar po'i nang du bh+ruṃ las rnam snang*/ de las gzhal yas khang grub bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi mtshan nyid tshang zhing rgyan thams cad rdzogs pa/ nang gi lha snam shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo bar yaṃ

la sogs bya/ gtso bo bskyed zin pa dang*/ sgo mtshams brgyad du pad nyi la bhaiṃ~X brgyad la ro langs chen po ka ha ka ha dang pheṃ pheṃ ha la ha la gyi sgra sgrogs pa gshin rje ltar khros pa/ mdog nag po mig gsum pa so rno ba gri thod 'dzin pa/ g.yon brkyang gi gar byed pa/ de nas/ mig tu k+ṣiṃ/ sogs bya ba snga ma ltar ro/ /ro langs mgo gsum lag gsum rkang gsum gar stabs zhes pa ni lugs gzhan no/ /rgyan thams cad rdzogs pa'i sgo mtshams brgyad du ro langs zhes sogs te khang pa dang lhan cig gi skad cig gis bskyed pa yang lugs gzhan no/ /phyag mtshan rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ lha snam byang ljang dbus sngon po gru bzhi pa'i steng rdo rje nag po'i rwa ba zlum po nang re mig dgu pa 'dzul sgo bzhi dang bcas shing*/ lho sgo phye ba gzhan rnams bcad pa/ dbus kyi re mig tu yaṃ la sogs nas/ bdag nyid du gyur/ shar du mgo bo/ lhor lag pa/ nub tu rgyu ma/ byang du rkang pa/ shar lhor thod pa/ lho nub tu thod tshal/ nub byang du ro ras/ byang shar du skyes bu gsal shing gis phug pa ste re mig rnams so/ /'khyam la shar du rim pas gri gug /'phang mdung*/ brtun shing*/ chu gri/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ lcags kyu/ lhor sta re/ mda'/ dbyug pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga/'khor lo/ zhags pa/ nub tu rdo rje/ cang te'u/ phub/ gzhu/ dril bu/ rlung ras/ byang du sdigs mdzub/ 'phan rtse gsum pa/ glang lpags/ tho ba/ mdung rings/ me thab/ sgo dang grwar ro langs sngar bzhin no/ /phyag mtshan sogs skyed nas dbus su yaṃ sogs skyed de/ ro langs kyang rang rang gi mgo bo lag g.yon na 'dzin pa yang kha cig 'dod do/ /phyag mtshan zhe dgu'i dkyil 'khor ni/ gzhan rnams bcad pa dbus su yaṃ sogs/ bdag nyid du gyur/ re mig brgyad la shar nas oṃ hrīḥṣ+tīḥbi/ me nas kṛ tā na na/ lha snam shar la yak+ṣe yats+tsha ni rā ma ya/ lhor ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/

nub tu ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ byang du ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya/ sgo bzhir ya mān ta ka /grwar bzhir hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du mgo bo sogs la/ lcags kyu/ ma he/ ba lang*/ zhags pa/ phag/bong bu/ rlung ras/ rnga mo/ khyi/ me thab/ lug /wa/ sgo bzhir bya rgod/ 'ug pa/ bya rogane tso/ khwa/ bya chen/ khyim bya/ bzhad/ 'di la'ang ro langs sngar bzhin no/ /yang rdo rje mgo bo nas/ rdo rje bzhad kyi bar gyi ming sbyar la thams cad g.yon thod pa g.yas rang ming gi phyag mtshan/ nag po ma he'i gdong cha lugs gtso bo lta bu zhes khyad par sbyar ba gzhan snga ma lta bu ni zhe dgu'i dkyil 'khor te bsdus pa'o/ /gtso bo bskyed pa'i rdo rje rwa lnga pa dang dgu pa ni 'di la gdam nga'o/ / dbus kyi le tshe'i nang du zhes pa dang*/ lha snam gyi dbus su zhes pa dang*/ gzhal yang khang mi bskyed pa'i phyogs la mchod rdzas sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i dbus zhes sbyar te/ thams cad la khrag zhag 'khrug pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil du thod skam gyi ra ba zlum po sgo gcig lhor bstan pa steng keng rus kyis thog phyur bur phug pa'i rtse mor mche ba gtsigs pa'i thod pa la gnas pa'i rdo rje'i rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i rgyan thams cad pa de'i nang gi dbus su yaṃ la sogs pa sbyor ba rwa lo chen po'i bzhed pa ste mi legs pa yang ma yin no/ /yang snga ma lta bu las tshogs bsog gi tshe snying gar pad zla la dhīḥ byed pa dang*/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung du yaṃ las rlung sogs/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i 'khyud rgya can/ thugs kar āḥlas nyi ma de la hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ gi 'od kyis rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ sngon bzhin mchod/ rang la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa

sogs snga ma bzhin no/ /'di la zhabs 'og gi ri skeg gi tshab tu khyim bya'o/ / sngags ni gsum po dang*/ yi ge bcu bzhi pa yang yin te/ gzhan yang cho ga de kho nas 'jig byed zhal bzhi pa rtsa zhal sngar ltar g.yas dmar g.yon dkar ba/ rwa gnyis kyi dbus su steng zhal khyi gdong dmar ser/ zhal thams cad spyan gsum rdo rje gad mo sogs/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rdo rje brtun shing*/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ cang te'u/ g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /thod pa/ gzhu/ zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs bzhis bdud bzhis mnan pa gcer bu sogs bya ste sngags ni sngar bstan pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa sa ༵ ch+gai mo bhak+ṣa ya phaṭa/ 'di gnyis dpa' bo gcig pa ste kha sbyor las 'byung pa paṇ+ḍi ta chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi bzhed pa ltar bkod pa yin la/ gzhan rnams rtog bdun gyi dgongs pa lā li ta'i gzhung chung dang mthu stobs dbang phyug rwa ba'i man ngan gtso bor byas la/ lā li ta'i gzhung che ba la'ang dpang por byas pa ste/ khro bo bcu'i bsrung 'khor sogs yod mod/ 'og tu ston ta ོ / /yang 'dir rwa lo chen po rdo rje grags kyi man ngag las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ pad nyi'i steng bdud bzhi'i steng du maṃ las ma he nag po rus pa'i rgyan can/ de'i steng du dhīḥlas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa las 'jam dbyangs sngar bzhin/ nyi ma'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yi ge 'bru gsum du spyan drangs te rang la thim pa las rang nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang zhal gsum/ phyag drug /zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa zhal ma he sogs/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis gri thod/ bar pa gnyis cang te'u kha ṭ+wāṃ ga/tha ma gnyis glang po che'o lpags rlon zhes pa khyad par ro/ / gzhan yang bdud bzhi'i dod du las kyi gshin rje kha sbub tu bsgyel ba'i steng du sogs dang*/ brgyan can/ de'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūṃ gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer gyis gdug pa thams cad tshar gcad/

snod bcud thams cad dkyil 'khor du gyur/ rang la thims/ yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid sogs dang*/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis pa/ sngar gyi phyag bar pa gnyis bor ba la gzhan snga ma ltar ro/ /'di'i phyag tha ma bor ba yang phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs te/ gzhan thams cad ni snga ma 'di kho na ltar sbyar ba yin no/ /'di rnams la yang*/ dkyil 'khor snga ma ltar sbyar bas mang por 'gyur te/ zhal dgu pa'i gnas su de rnams so/ /de bas na gang la mos pa de la de sbyin no/ /zhe dgu rgyas pa bcu gsum ma sogs ni 'dor len tsam gyis don 'grub pa dka' bar mthong bas 'dir mi 'bri'o/ /de ltar lnga las brgyad du phye ba sogs mang por 'gyur ro/ /bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor yang rnam par ma dag pa'o zhes smra bar mi bya ste rtog pa bdun par bskyed rim gang gsungs pa'i don thams cad tshang la/ lhag ma yang 'di nyid dang mthun pa'i rgyud kyis dag par kha bskang ba'i ting nge 'dzin rgyas pa ste/ rdo rje slob dpon chen po ye shes zhabs sogs kyi man ngag dang*/ lā li ta'i gzhung dang lhag par mthun pas shin tu legs so/ /sgrub thabs rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus par grags pa'i lugs bcu bdun ma ni yan lag phyi ma rnams spyi mthun la/ dang po'i rgyu rdor sems 'jam dpal mi mdzad pa/ dpal bde mchog gi sgrub thabs lū yi pa'i lugs dang mthun pa zhig ste/ 'dir ni rtog bdun nyid kyi dgongs pa brjod pa las ni/ de ni rgyud gzhan la brten pa'am/ man ngag 'ga' zhig tsam ste/ deng mi brjod pa kho na'o/ /ye shes zhabs kyi man ngag ltar slob dpon ka ma la rak+ṣi tas/ sgrub thabs byas pa bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor yang de ltar ro/ /'dir smras pa/ 'di la bskyed pa'i rim pa ci// de'i sbyang gzhi'i rab dbye ci/ /rgyu dang de bzhin gong ma'i lam/ /'bras bu chos mthun dag kyang gang*/ /brjod pa/ ye shes tshogs gsog gis 'chi ba sbyong zhing 'od gsal du byed/

rten gyi dkyil 'khor gyis gang du skye ba'i snod dang*/ rlung dang zla ba rlung sems phra mo/ sa bon phyag mtshan dag sems kyi rgyu 'jam dpal ni/ bar do'i 'gro ba dang*/ ye shes kyi sku/ nyi ma ni 'od gsal ba/ dkyil 'khor bstim pa ni bar ma'i srid pa 'gag pa'i tshul/ zla ba dang bcas pa'i 'jam dpal nyi ma la zhugs pa ni khu khrag dang sems gcig tu 'dres pa/ nyi ma yi ge rdo rje rnams ni mer mer po la sogs pa/ spro bsdus sbyor ba ni/ 'byung ba bzhi'i stobs las gong nas gong du 'phel ba/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyogs la/ rwa ni yan lag lnga dang nying lag nyer lnga'o/ /dgu pa la ni phung po lnga dang 'byung ba lnga'o/ /sku rdzogs pa ni btsas pa/ nye bar bsgrub pa ni/ lus 'phel ba/ sgrub pa ni lo bcu drug lon pa ltar lus dang ngag dang yid dang bde ba rdzogs pa/ sgrub pa chen po ni rang gi gnas la dbang bskur zhing*/ 'gro ba'i bya ba la gnas pa'o zhes pa 'di la phal cher ni sbyangs gzhi'i rab tu dbye ba dang*/ la la ni chos mtshungs pa dag ste/ de dag gi snang ba dang der zhen pa zlog pa ste/ gang dag de la sangs rgyas kyi ye shes su zhen pas kyang ngo*/ /ji ltar zhe na/ srid pa gsum po la sogs pa'ang yang dag pa'i mtha' dang*/ mngon byang lngas rgyal ba'i sku 'grub pa dang*/ sprul pa'i skus 'gro ba'i don spyod pa dang*/ de'i ye shes thams cad gcig tu gyur pa dang*/ dbang bskur thob pa rnams su'o// des na rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba yang*/ 'di dang 'dis dpag par nus so/ /'di dag la zhal dang phyag la sogs pa rdul du snang ba dang*/ lus kyi cha shas tsam gyi nga rgyal ni rnam par dag par mi 'gyur te/ ji skad bshad pa'i rnam par dag pa de dang*/ de'i nga rgyal bya ste/ 'di ltar zhabs rnams ni srin bu rkang mangs lta bu ma yin gyi/ dbang phyug brgyad dang*/ grub pa brgyad stsol ba'i thugs rje'i ye shes rnam pa der snang ba'o snyam pa lta bu'o/

/de ltar/ zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i tshul la/ 'khor ba'i tshul de dang de dag pa dang*/ 'bras bu de dang de dngos kyi nga rgyal ma 'gags par bsgom mo/ /'dir yang smras pa/ bskyed pa'i rim pa rmad byung zhig /de ring kun dga' snying pos bstan/ / yi ge nyung zhing don mang ba/ /'di yis blo nus dpog min nam/ /nyin re'am zla ba so so'am/ /yang na lo ni re rer ni/ /dbyug gu drug cu rtsa bzhir bcas/ /gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhir sbyin/ /de yang 'pho ba re re la/ me rlung sa chu rgyu ba'i dbyug gu re re te drug cu rtsa bzhi las sa chu la dge ba dang me rlung la drag las sam dbang gi las bya ba dang*/ yang na/ zhag gcig la dkyil 'khor gyi bdag nyid kyi dbyug gu drug cu rtsa re re/ 'pho mtshams kyi ye shes kyi cha rnams la/ dbyug gu bzhir byas nas/ de dag 'jig rten du dus kyi pho nya dang bar chad du 'gyur ba las/ nang gi rnal 'byor gyi stobs kyis/ 'chi med rdo rje'i sku'i bar du bya ba'i phyir/ rnam 'gyur bsad bskrad zhi ba dang*/ rang bzhin dbang dgug rgyas sogs su byed pa nang gi nges pa ste/ de lta bu'i de nyid shes pas gzhan don bya ba'am/ las dang po pas kyang gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi'i nges pas/ las tshogs bde blag tu 'grub pa ni de ltar yin la/ gtor ma phul bas rang yang mchog gi don de myur du 'grub pa'i rten 'brel zab mor 'gyur te/ 'di bya ba ni/ bris sku'i mdun du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang khrag chen po dang chang bsres pa'i dri bzang gi chus maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi bya/ der chos 'byung dkar po/ rtse mo rang la lta ba/ nang dmar pos byugs la/ dbus zlum skor le tshe dgu pa byas pa'i le tshe phyogs mdog /dbus su bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha grangs ji tsam yod pa dang*/ le tshe brgyad la phyogs skyong bcu'i tshom bu dgod/ chos 'byung gi g.yas su 'das pa'i gtor ma che ba zhig thod pa'am snod gang yang rung bar bshams/

g.yon du 'byung po thams cad pa/ rgyab bam mdun gang ba der las kyi gshin rje gtor ma/ de thams cad sha khrag sna tshogs pas spags te/ ba dan la sogs pas brgyan/ gtor ma'i rgyu zan sha khrag nya sgog tsong chang 'bru sna tshogs pa las bya/ snod gcig tu gshoms pa'am/ snod gzhan du drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gtor ma'ang bzhi tshan nam bcu drug tshan ci rigs long skabs dang bstun par bshams/ dbyibs ni bod rnams las dang mthun pa'i dbyibs ltar mdzad par snang bas de ltar yang rung ngo*/ /de la 'dir sha khrag chang rnams rdzas kyi gtso bo yin no/ /de nas mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung sogs yan lag bzhi rdzogs par bskyed pa'am bsdu na/ hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor oṃ hri ha bho sogs kyis mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du spyan drangs te bzhugs zhes bya/ de nas mchod yon sogs phyag rgya dang bcas dbul te/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tīḥha/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ku ma ra rū pī ni dzaḥdzaḥ oṃ hriḥha hai phaṭa/ oṃ dip+ta lo tsa na bi kṛ tā na na mahā aṭ+ṭaṭ+ṭa hā sa na di na dip+ta ya swāhā/ oṃ bi kri tā na na duṣ+ta satwa da ma ka gaḥgaḥgaḥ oṃ kā la rū pa sar+b+ba duṣ+ta satwa da ma ka /mahā bhū ta a dhī pa ti i maṃ bā ling gṛ ha ṇa pa ta ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ de nas snying po'i mthar oṃ āḥhūṃ btags te nang mchod do/ /yid kyi rig ma sprul pa phul ste/ bde ba chen pos snyoms par zhugs/ oṃ a nu rā ga 'i sngags rgya bya/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /longs spyod yul du du mar snang*/ /shel la tshon ni ji bzhin du/ /'dod yon lnga dang chos rnams la/ /rnal 'byor rtag tu spyod par shog /a la la ho/ rol du gsol/ bsnams par mdzod/ mi 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu la/ / dges pa'i gar gyis rol par mdzod/

/reg bya 'gag pa med pa la/ /mig yor bzhin du rol du gsol/ /ho chags pa med bzhin chags par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba pū dza sogs/ dur khrod rgyan gyi legs brgyan pa'i/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po ni/ /dngos med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /thugs rjes sprul pa'i skur bstan pa'i/ /ye shes khro rgyal rab 'jigs pa/ /dud kha mun chen khyod la 'dud/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta stu ti ra badz+ra swa bhā bāt+ma ko3haṃ/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung raṃ las me kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum la/ a las thod pa de'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga'i steng du/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ k+ṣe ma me da ya las ye shes lnga/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas bcu yi ge dang bcas pa zhu ba'i spris ma sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar mi bskyod pas gtso byas pa'i rigs lnga yab yum snyoms par 'jug bzhin pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad rigs lnga'i rnam pas rang rang gi zhal du zhugs/ yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i rkyen gyis bde ba chen po'i bdud rtsir zhu ste ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ

'di ni man ngag go / de'i nang bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūṃ las sgron ma lnga/ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ baṃ las bdud rtsi lngar gyur pa la/ rang rang gi yi ges mtshan pa/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūṃ rim pas brtsegs pa/ rlung sogs zhu zhing 'dres/ yig 'bru gsum gyi 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje gsum gyi lhar spyan drangs/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu zhing thim pas gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi sogs bya ba ni khyad par te lugs gzhan no/ / oṃ ya ma rā dza sogs dang*/ hrīḥṣ+tīḥ dang*/ ya mān+ta ka 'i mthar/ sarba bigh+nān sha trun mā ra ya i daṃ bā liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi swāhā/ zhes pa bdun la sogs pas gtor ma 'bul/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ badz+ra bhai ra bā dhi pa ta ye i dam bā ling kha kha khā hi khā hi hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa'ang gtor sngags so/ /de nas mchod bstod gsol ba btab/ rang gi snying ga nas khro bo lcags kyu thogs pa spros pa rnams kyis phyogs skyong rnams bkug/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ hūṃ in+d+ra a dī nāṃ ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor du 'khod/ phur bu bcu spros nas de rnams kyi spyi bor btab/ hrīḥṣ+tīḥ 'i mthar hūṃ in+d+ra a dī naṃ badz+ra kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ grub pa'i bcud kyis reg pa ltar thams cad rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis par gyur/ gong ltar skye mched dang gnas gsum byin gyis rlob/ dbang gi lha rigs lngas dbang bskur te/ gshin rje gshed kyis dbu brgyan/ dang por gtor ma lan gcig phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol gdab/ de nas tshan pa ji tsam bcad pa rnams so so la/ nang mchod gtor bsangs sbyangs 'bru gsum rlung dang bstun nas byin rlabs bya/ gtor ma dang grangs mnyam pa'i sngags rgyas phul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis nang mchod/ bstod pa dang 'dod don gsol btab bsdus re bya la/ mthar mjug tu mchod bstod sogs bya/

de la/ oṃ in+d+ra ya hrīḥ ya ma ya ṣ+tīḥ ku be rā ya kṛ/ ī sha nā ya ta/ ag+ne ya a/ ni ri t+ya na/ ba ya be na/ prah+ma ya hūṃ/ ba sun+dha ri phaṭa/ sarba bhū te bh+yo ha ha hi hi hūṃ hūṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaṭa swāhā/ 'di ni gtor sngags so/ / yang na/ oṃ bhu tsa rā naṃ/ ya pā tā la tsa rā naṃ/ mān khe tsa rā naṃ/ ta pur+b+bā dhi ga tā naṃ/ ka dak+ṣi ṇā' dhi ga ta naṃ/ hūṃ pañtsi mā dhi ga tā naṃ/ phaṭa ut+ta ra a dhi ga tā naṃ/ oṃ i hrīḥya ṣ+tī ba/ bi k+ṣo kṛ ko ta e na a na de hūṃ bh+yaḥphaṭa sarba bhū te bh+yāḥ i maṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms/ /dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po/ /gshin rje mthar byed phyag 'tshal zhing*/ /phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /bcom ldan 'das dang phyogs skyong tshogs/ / mchod spyin rgya chen 'dis tshims pas/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /phan dang bde la gegs byed pa'i/ /'gal rkyen bar chad phyi nang gsang*/ / skad cig nyid la ni wa ra ya phaṭa/ /mthun rkyen thams cad 'grub pa dang*/ / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ / zhes pa ni bstod pa dang 'dod don zhu ba'o/ /de nas/ snying ga'i 'od kyis/ chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tīḥ sogs dang*/ ya ma rā dza sa pā ri wa ra kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dam rgya bcas te/ oṃ nas/ sa pā ri wā ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dam la bzhag dbang bskur bas rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūṃ/ i daṃ bā ling grih+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ bcom ldan chos rje 'jam dbyangs spyan lam du/ /bdud 'dul bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa/ /las kyi gshin rje ma mo mkha' 'gro ma/ /'byung po ro langs ci bgyi bka' nyan sogs/ / phyi nang gsang ba'i dam can ma lus la/ /bdag ni re ba'i sems kyis 'dud cing mchis/

/chos kyi rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin chen pos tshim gyur te/ /bstan dang sems can yongs la 'tshe/ /gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /rdul phran tsam yang med par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams/ /snying nas byang chub mchog sgrubs pa'i/ /'phral dang yun gyi 'gal rkyen rnams/ /bzlog cing bsgyur la rdul du rlogs/ /rnam 'gyur rnam dag chos kyi dbyings/ /mnyam nyid chen por drag sbyor mdzod/ / ces thal mo brdabs/ thun gtor/ zor du 'phen pa phyir zlog gi cha shas su 'gyur zhes skyo pa rnams phyag len du mdzad do// gshin rje gshed kyi yig brgya brjod/ kā la rū pa sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha zhes sam/ yang na/ dza ya dza ya su dza ya/ zhes sogs/ slar yang*/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas la mchod/ dngos grub blangs/ bzod par gsol/ yi ge brgya pa'i bzlas pa bya/ oṃ dza ya dza ya su dza ya bi shwa rū pa dha ri gats+tsha gats+tsha swa s+thā naṃ kṛ tan+te na thā gats+tsha sar+b+ba bud+dha sh+tsa bi sar+dz+dza ya/ ma ma kar+m+maṃ ku ru swāhā/ gtor mgron rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ dge ba bsngo/ shis pa brjod do/ /'di ni phyi rol mchod pa/ gtor chog dang bcas pa shin tu bsdus pa ste rgyas par gzhan du blta'o/ /mchod pa'i tshe rol mo sna tshogs pa brdung zhing*/ khyad par cang te'u thod pa'i rang bzhin te/ bstod pa dang*/ gtor ma bskyel ba na yang ngo*/ /gal te phyogs skyong bco lnga la ni gtor sngags kyang de ltar sbyor ro/ /'dir smras pa/ bcud len mchog gis reg na lcags kyang gser/ / sngags kyi mthu las dug kyang bdud rtsir 'gyur/ /'chi ba ster byed dbyug gu'i ye shes cha/ /thabs mkhas sbyor las dngos grub rnam gnyis rgyu/ /da ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa shin tu zab mo 'thor thabs su gnas pa dag 'dir bsdu ste/ dang po shan+ti pa zhes grags pa thams cad mkhyen pa lta bu des mdzad pa'i tshogs 'khor du/

snying ga'i lte bar zla ba la chos 'byung dmar po'i nang du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ spyi bo'i steng mtho gang tsam gyis dpags pa zla ba'i 'og tu oṃ mgo bo thur bstan/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ oṃ dang zla ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung*/ spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ snying ga'i rdo rjer thim nas/ nus pa bde drod rlan dang bcas pa lus thams cad la khyab yang yang sgom zhing rdo rje la sems 'dzin/ 1 spyi bor bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rgyun zhal dgu so sor drangs/ mthar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la bstim pa yang yang sgom ste/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la gtso bor sems 'jog go 2 /yang dngos sam yid kyi rig ma dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i thig le yungs 'bru tsam rdo rje'i rtse mo'am shes rab kyi sna rtser sgom pa/ 3 yang man ngag nang gi rnal 'byor gyi skabs bstan te dang po gnyis ni bsam gtan gyi dug gzhil ba'i cho ga'i nges don yin la/ gzhan yang 'dir rdzogs rim phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor bstan pa dang*/ spyod pa'ang tshogs 'khor gyis don gyis bstan to/ /'di rnams ye shes zhabs dang mthun no/ /rwa lo chen po'i bzhed pa'i de'i man ngag bcud thig sogs su 'byung ba'i gdams pa sna tshogs pa dag bsdu na/ shin tu spros pa med pa zab mo'i dbyings lhan cig skyes pa'i man ngag ni/ rang sems spros med lhan skyes la/ spros bcas glo bur pa thams cad spangs te/ lhan skyes kyi ngang skyong ba/ rnam rtog gang byung mi 'thud pa dus skabs thams cad du de'i rgya dang ma bral ba 'di gsum la ma bcos pa/ rtsa ba med pa/ rang shar zhes pa'i mtshan gsol te/ gzung 'dzin spros med mtshan mo rgyu ba'i man ngag go 4 /yang thig le'i rnal 'byor bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel la/ steng gi sna sgor zla ba ma shaka tsam la rdo rje sngon po yungs 'bru tsam de la sems ngar bskyed de sgom pa dang*/ 5 gsang rtse'i bu kar zla ba rdo rje dmar skya yungs 'bru tsam la dang slod pa ste 'di gnyis kyis bying rgod kyang sel/

zab pa'i rnal 'byor/ 6 de brtan na stong gsum yungs 'brur bsdud/ rdul phran gyis stong gsum khyab pa'i spro bsdu byed pa rgya che ba la brlab pa'i rnal 'byor zhes gsungs/ 7 yang rgyud kyi bzlas dmigs kyi nges don/ rtog pa bzhi par/ de kho na nyid kyi sbyor ba la shin tu mnyam par gzhag pa'i sngags pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i skabs su 'chad de/ man ngag ni/ rdzogs rim sems dpa' gsum brtsegs zhes bya/ de yang*/ bzlas pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus kyi ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ hūṃ de nyid dam/ de zhu ba'i thig le mdog khrag shas che na dkar po/ rlung shas che na dmar po/ snyoms na dkar dmar ro gsungs te don du dkar dmar ro/ /de'i 'od kyis rim gyis/ khyab mthar dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs mun khung sgron me bteg pa ltar gsal/ slar rim gyis rim gyis hūṃ la bsdus pa ring du yid gtad/ de yang brtan brtan du yang yang bsgom/ yang sngar bzhin spros nas thams cad bsdus te ma he'i zhal du thim/ yang spros te gsal 'debs/ de ltar gsal snang nam thob kyi bar du bya ba ste rgya che ba la sems bzung ba'o/ 8 /yang snga ma ltar spros/ thams cad 'od du zhu bdag la thim/ rang ye shes sems dpa'/ de ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ de na da/ ches phra bar bsdu/ de la sems brtan na/ de yang yal ba'i mtha' bral la 'jog pa ni/ zab pa la bslab pa/ 9 yang skad cig gis spros nas snang stong dbyer med la 'jog pa zung 'jug la bslab pa'o/ 10 /de rnams ni ye shes zhabs dang mthun la/ phal che a ba dhū ti'i nang du bsgom pa shas che ba yin no/ /ma he'i zhal zhes pa'i nang don/ rwa sgom pa ni lte bar nyi zla brtsegs pa la ma he'i gdong brgyad brtsegs pa'i/ steng ma'i rwa gang rung gi rtse'i nang du/ nā da'i re kha phra mo la sems 'dzin cing*/ chos thams cad spros pa dang bral ba'o zhes yang yang sgom/ 11 mtshan ma gyen 'greng gi rnal 'byor la rnal 'byor lam pas sgom pa ni lha sku 'ja' lus kyi lte ba'i khong stong du hūṃ nag po/

de'i 'og tu āḥdamar po rlung bum can bzung bas/ 'og rlung yar log na yi ge gnyis la thim/ de gnyis las 'od dmar nag gnyis sna bug nas glog 'gyu ba bzhin byung snang ba thams cad gsal/ sngar gyi lam nas yi ge gnyis la thim pa la sems 'jog pa/ sa bon la sems 'dzin pa/ 12 'od gnyis kyi snang ba thams cad zhu rang la bsdu/ rang yi ge de nā da'i bar du bsdus nas/ nā da je phra la sems 'dzin pa/ nā da la sems 'dzin pa'o/ 13/ 'di las rlung sems las su rung ba na/ chags lam las rgya brten pa'i mtshan ma gyen bsgreng bsgom/ 14 thig le 'gog pa mtshan ma gyen bsgreng zhes bya ba rlung 'ong ba bde ba/ 'gro ba sdug bsngal/ rgyu ba chad pa btang snyoms/ phyir rgyus nang du ma brgyus par rnam rtog rang bzhin gyis 'gag /spros pa nub pas de gnyis kyi bar de gnyis su sems gtad de/ ma bcos pa'i tshul gyis had de ba yid mig rlung gsum sna rtser hril gril ba ste/ bde ba'i ye shes rang shar ngang thig le rang 'gag su 'byung*/ ril ba zhags tshags kyi dpe dang 'dra'o/ 15 /bsam gtan gyi rtog par ba mo zhu ba dang*/ 'o ma can gyi shing 'dzag pa'i nges don gzhan 'og nas 'byung ba dang 'dra la/ dang po 'og sgo la sbyar nas phyag rgya'i dwangs ma 'dren pa dang*/ phyi ma shing gi don rtsa dbu ma yin pas dbu ma'i nang du 'byung ba rnams sgom pa dang*/ baṃ gyi dod haṃ la byed pa lugs 'di pa'i khyad par te/ de rnams bde dgyes sogs dang mthun no/ 16 /'od gsal la sems dpa' gsum rtseg ni/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ji bzhin las/ sngags 'phreng mi bsgom/ ye shes sems dpa' dbu ma'i nang gi lte snying gar rung du bsgom/ hūṃ gi 'od kyis rjes gzhig sgom mo/ /rwa pa gong ma rnams kyis 'jigs byed kyi 'pho ba bsgom pa'i gsal kha med/ phyi ma rnams dang*/ skyo pa rnams yi ge gcig pa zhig bsgom/ phyis kyi mkhas pa kha cig sam+bu ṭi'i lugs de mdzad mod/

de thams cad rgyud 'dir ni 'dis bstan med la/ rdzogs rim dngos ma yin pas 'dir ma bris so/ /bla ma skyo pa'i man ngag zab mo rwa rtse sems 'dzin ni/ rang dpa' gcig chos 'byung dkar por gnas pa'i snying gar/ rgyu'i 'jam dpal pad dkar la gnas pa/ 'od dpungs 'khrigs pa/ rwa sngo bsangs dwangs gsal rtse rno zul ba'i nang du thig le dkar la 'tsher ba/ de las thig le'i rgyun byung*/ mgrin par gcig tu 'dres/ snying ga'i 'jam dpal gyi spyi bo nas thim pas/ lus sems bde bas khyab pa la sems gtad/ byang sems bde ba'i 'od dkar po liṅga rab tu rgyas pa nas yar byung*/ sku'i phyi yang khebs/ sems can thams cad la phog pas bde ba'i ngo bor gyur/ rang lha sku dngul chu'i thigs pa lta bu'i gsal dwangs 'tsher ba la sems 'jog pa'o/ 17 /mtshan mo rgyu ba ni dus rtag tu 'jigs byed kyi gsal snang dang*/ nga rgyal shugs che ba yud re de yang gsal stong rang shar tsam/ de tsam ma gtogs dmigs med nyid la bzhag /mtshan mo gcer bu gri thod 'dzin tshul bya/ sna rtser sems cher gtad/ nga rgyal brtan pos gom pa bdun tsam rgyu/ rnam rtog gang byung spros med du thag bcad/ 'jigs pa/ ya nga*/ bag tsha/ g.yang sa me chu sogs thams cad la/ rang dang dbyer med du bsres nas/ cher gyis lta ba'i yid kyis thog rdzis bya/ de nas je ring du rgyu/ mthar gyang sogs la thogs pa med na thun mong gi dngos grub yud kyis 'grub pa yin gsung*/ 18 gtum mo ni/ bsam gtan gyi rtog pa'i bu mo dbang du byed pa'i des don te/ rkang par rlung sngon po zla gam/ sum mdor me dmar po gru gsum/ snying gar sa ser po gru bzhi/ dpral bar zla ba gang ba chu'i rang bzhin rnams la yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ rlung kha sbyor bzung*/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ sa bsregs/ baṃ zhu ba gsang ba'i zhu/ ldog byed pa'i 'bar 'dzag sgom pa'o/ 19 /co gru lo tsā ba chen po'i bzhed pas 'khor lo bzhi'i gtum mo sgom par bzhed pa ni shin tu legs shing*/

'on kyang de'i dmigs pa dpyid thig yi ge bzhi pa nyid yin pas der blta'o/ 20 /de ltar zhang skyo rwa gsum ka'i lugs la'ang zab mo phyag rgya'i lam rgyas par 'byung mod/ 'dir mi 'chad la/ rnal 'byor gyi lam de tsam mo/ /mal gyo lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa nā ro pa'i man ngag da lta sa lugs su grags pa'i rdzogs rim 'di ni/ mtshan ma gyen 'greng gi nang don/ rdzogs rim zhig yin te/ dngos ni lag pa'i phyag rgya la brten pa'i man ngag tu gtogs pa'o// de yang*/ rdo rje bslang ba rtag tu bya/ /zla ba nyi ma'i 'gro 'ongs dgag /gzhan du a ba dhū tī'i char/ / mi 'jug pa ni rlung yin no/ /mtshan mo du ba/ smig rgyu srin bu me khyer/ mar me 'bar ba/ nyin mo/ zla ba/ nyi ma/ zla ba sngon po/ gzugs brnyan mthong ba/ sku gsum mthong ba/ de nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid do/ /'di'i don rlung dbu mar ma bcings pas/ byang sems dbu mar mi chud/ de ltar na sdug bsngal 'byung*/ ting nge 'dzin mi skye/ gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog bskyed pa'i rten byed/ de dbu mar chud pas gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog 'gag pa'i bar du byed/ de 'gags pas bde stong lhan cig skyes pa chos sku mngon du byed ces 'byung*/ 'dir rdo rje bslang ba'i lag len/ lag g.yas phyin ka log tu phar bstan pa'i mtheb mdzub bar dog par snol ba'i bug pa rdo rje bcug la/ de'i rtsa bar bzhag pas rlung dang byang sems phar mi 'chor/ mig gnyis ma phye mi 'dzum pa/ nam mkha' la lta/ 'dzin med lhug pa gzhag /rgyu zhabs yar bskum steng rlung sna 'gul tsam drangs te mar mnan/ rlung gtong ba na/ steng 'og gnyis ka dal bus slod/ de nas je drag je drag dgag ste bde stong mi rtog pa mchog skye ste srog rtsol lo/ /de ltar bsgom na rtags ni du ba sogs bcu la nyin mtshan so sor lnga lnga'o/ /sku gsum ni rang sems dang dngos po'i 'dres pa'i bde stong chos sku/

lus 'ja' tshon ltar yang ba longs sku/ ci 'dod pa'i rnam par 'char zhing ston pa sprul sku zhes pa lam dus so// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni 'bras dus kyi sku gsum mo/ 21 /'di na rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim thor bu pa brgyud pa so so'i gdam ngag phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i 'khrid chen po byed pa dang*/ rgya gzhung tha dad la brten pa zhal phyag gi dag pa dang sbyar ba'i rdzogs rim chen po byed pa'ang 'dug mod kyi/ man ngag thor bur bstan pa'i rdzogs rim bla ma ches snga rabs pa'i lugs 'di dag ches yid ches par snang ngo*/ /'dir rdzogs rim spyi 'gros ni 'dus pa dang mthun/ de'i nang gi yang zhabs lugs dang gsang ba grub pa sogs dang mthun shas che bar snang ngo*/ /'dir smras pa/ bde chen gcig pu'i dngos ni thun tshod zhal te mtshan ma'i snyems pa stug po dag la ches khros pa/ /dus mthu'i char sprin dkrigs khyod rdo rje'i gar gyis sa gsum 'dar mdzad sgyu 'phrul rdo rje gsus po che// lhan skyes stong nyid bcu drug bde stong ngo bo'i phyag ni byang chub phyogs cha'i mtshon gdengs thabs shes rwa/ /rtse mo rnon pos srid zhi'i mtha' gnon grub pa dbang phyug rnams kyi zhabs ni don gnyis mchog brnyes pa/ /de nyid sgrub thabs nges gsang bdud rtsi'i 'od/ /bcu drug khyim du rtag shar brjod bral che/ /ris med lhan skyes gnyis snang gdung sel ba/ /dpal ldan 'gyur med rdo rje'i rdzogs pa'i rim/ /de ltar na bar ma chad par rim pa gnyis la 'bad cing nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni zhu bde'i rnal 'byor gtso bor bya'o/ /de nas ye shes phebs pa dang*/ ye shes la cung zad dbang ba dang*/ ye shes la ches dbang ba rnams su/ rim gyis dbang po smin nas gdod rdzogs pa'i rim pa la rtse gcig tu dril nas/ spyod pa spyad pas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob bo/ /gal te 'dir lha'i rnal 'byor dang bzlas pa las su rung ba mtshan ma brtan po shar ba'am/

de ma yin na sngags bye ba la sogs pa'am/ tha mar yang rgyud las gsungs pa bzhi 'gyur du bzlas la/ sbyin bsreg gis 'dod pa'i lha mgu bar byas pa zhig gis bya ste/ dkyil 'khor bris te sgrub pa zhag bdun du bya ba/ sngon du bsnyen sgrub sbrags pa zla ba drug tu byas pas yin te/ des kyang mtshan ma ma rnyed na de 'dra ba lan gsum du bya ste/ de la bcom ldan 'das zhal ston pa'am/ de lta bu'i mtshan ma sgra dang 'od 'byin pa dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis dngos su byin gyis rlob bo/ /de nas las thams cad thogs pa med par 'gyur la/ dngos grub rnams kyang sgrub par bya'o/ /des rig pa 'dzin pa ma grub na yang las kyi dngos grub gdon mi za bar gsungs so/ /gzhan du na/ dngos grub ni mi 'grub la/ las kyang thogs shing don chung ba tsam zhig 'grub po zhes rig ste/ de yang*/ rgyud 'dir tshar bcad pa nyid gtso bor ston cing*/ las tshogs ni bsam gtan dang*/ sbyin bsreg dang*/ 'khrul 'khor gyi las tshogs gsum du 'du zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin la snang ba rnyed pa dang*/ bzlas brjod kyi mthu pa che ba dang*/ chung ba'i dbye ba ste gsum mo/ /dang po la bsad pa/ dbye ba/ skrod pa/ dgug pa/ dug bsal ba/ bud med zhu ba'i sbyor ba/ skyes bu chen po dbang du byed pa rnams gsungs/ gnyis pa la/ spyir sbyor ba'i cho ga gsungs pa'i rjes la bsad pa'i las gnyis/ dbye ba gnyis/ bskrad pa'i las bzhi/ mnan pa/ bu mo dbang du byed pa/ zhi bar byed pa/ rgyas par byed pa/ dgug pa/ smyo bar byed pa/ de zhi ba/ rdzas dang rdzas ma yin pa bsgyur ba/ yul dbang du byed pa/ dbang du byas nas bran du sgrub pa/ 'byor pa bskyed pa/ rgyal po dang 'jig rten dang*/ bud med rnams dbang du byed pa re re/ dbang du byed pa'i mchog/dgug pa'i mchog rnams bstan to/ /de rnams kyang sbyin bsreg byas pa'i dgos pa/ byed pa po/

gnas/ dus/ yul/ las bzhir 'dus pa'i rgyu mtshan/ thab khung*/ dgang blugs/ rdzas/ me rnams kyi rab byed/ phyi nang gsang ba'i sbyin bsreg la sogs pa rnams grangs mang por shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa la bsad pa drug /bskrad pa lnga/ dbye ba bzhi/ rims kyis 'debs pa/ rengs pa/ mnan pa/ dbang du byed pa/ 'gugs pa/ smyo bar byed pa/ bu mo rmongs shing 'gugs pa/ zhi ba'i las mdor bstan pa rnams gsungs/ thun mong gi dngos grub ral gri /mig sman/ sa 'og /ri lu/ bcud len/ gter/ 'byung po/ ro langs/ sha za/ gnod sbyin/ gnod sbyin mo/ klu la sogs pa ji snyed pa sgrub pa ste de rnams sgrub tshul dmar nag gi rgyud nas 'byung ba ltar bya/ las tshogs thun mong pa rnams kyang 'dra la/ thun mong ma yin pa sngar bshad pa de rnams so/ /de la 'khrul 'khor rkyang ba dang*/ sbrags ma'i 'khor lo bdun bsdus pa la re mig phyi brgyad nang brgyad de bcu drug /rgyas pa la phal cher nag po'i rgyud dang mthun/ yang rtog gsum nas bshad pa re mig bcu bdun pa de dag la las kyi dbye bas rnam pa mang por 'gyur zhing*/ sngar bstan pa'i 'khrul 'khor skabs kyi las tshogs la kha cig 'di ltar bzhed/ yi ge bcu pa'i drug ste bsad pa dang po/ rims kyis gdab pa gnyis pa/ rengs pa gsum pa/ bskrad pa gcig ste/ 'khor lo brten pa bzhi/ dbye ba gnyis ni ma bsten pa ste drug ga

ོ /yi ge so gnyis pas las nyi shu ste zhi ba dbang dgug gsum la re re/ bsad pa gsum/ mtshon gyis phog pa/ de'i phyogs su bsdus pa ste gcig/bskrad dbye rengs gsum la gsum gsum ste 'khor lo bsten pa'o/ /mi brten pa la bsad bskrad la gnyis gnyis ste nyi shu'o/ /zhes gsungs te rgyud kyi dngos bstan der gnas la/ man ngag gi 'khrul 'khor bdun sogs mdzad pa'ang legs pa kho na'o/ /'di rnams la rgyud gzhan ltar las tshogs spyi yi chos brgyad dang*/ bri gzhi/ snag tsha/ snyug gu /bri thabs kyi cho ga /bri ba dngos/ sgrubs pa/ 'khor lo las la sbyar ba/ ma grub pa spogs chog ste don brgyad dam/ thog mar sa la bri ba'i phyogs la/ sngags bri ba/ btu ba/ drang ba/ bsre ba dang*/ spo ba/ sgrub pa/ sba ba zhes pa'i tshul gyis las la sbyor/ rtog gsum gyi tshul dang*/ dmar po sogs dang thun mong pa gnyis ka yang rtog bdun gyi dgongs par ni gnas par mngon/ yi ge bcu bdun gyi las bcu bdun sgrubs pa na/ bris gzhi/ srog gzugs/ mtha' rten/ spel tshig /lha sngags/ yi ge mgo ston tshul tha dad pa yod pa ltar bya zhing*/ khyad par drag po la kha sbyor dbye ba bzhi ste/ ye shes sems dpa'i dang*/ lus bsrung ba'i dang*/ snying dkar nag gi dang*/ sha rus kha sbyor dbye ba dang*/ lha dang mi'i gsang sde bzhi dang dbye ba dang nyi ma bzhi pa'i las sbyor dang*/ spogs chog gnyis la sngags kyang 'di ltar/ oṃ ya ma rā ni ts+tsha ya k+ṣe ya yak+ṣe ya ra ni yo da ya ya da yo ṇa ru do me ya ya me do sa dza rā ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ ya ma me dak+ṣe ya ts+tsha ni dzā sa do ru ṇa yo ni ra dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ yak+ṣe ma me da yo ni ra yats+tsha rā dzā sa do ru ṇa dgra bo mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa'o/ /bzlas pa/ 'khor lo dang*/ sbyin bsreg /gtor ma/ tshogs 'khor sogs gcig tu gril nas sgrub par gsungs la/

'khrul 'khor yang bla ma snga rabs pa mang po/ zhi ba 'jigs pa brgyad la skyob zhes sogs kyis rnam grangs mang por 'gyur bar bzhed pa yang*/ las kyi rgyud dang grogs bstan pa'i skabs yin pas shin tu mi 'thad pa yang ma yin la/ de ltar gang dgos pa'i dus su de dang de sgrub pa yin no/ /yang mchod sbyin dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ bzlas pa dang*/ sbyin bsreg dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ las kyi kha skong ba ste las bdun gyis zhi drag sogs thams cad sgrub bo/ /de yang*/ bsnyen pa dang*/ bsnyen sgrub sbags ma sngon du song ba'am/ sgrub pa song bas las dang po gzhi rnams rgya cher sngon du btang nas/ drag po ni/ nyi ma bdun nam/ bzhir bsgrubs nas las la sbyor te/ kha lhor phyogs/ dur khrod kyi ras la dug la sogs pa drug byug la/ snag tsha la yang bsre/ rgyas pa'am/ rtog gsum ltar bri ba'am/ phyi brgyad nang brgyad sogs gang yang rung ba bri/ sa gzhi la ma bris pa'i phyogs la/ bsangs sbyangs/ de nyid lha bcu bdun du bskyed/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs par byas/ mchod bstod gtor ma dbul/ las dang mthun pa'i gdan la/ ming yig rnams sgrub byar bskyed/ dgug gzhug bya/ go cha dang lha la sogs pa dbral/ yang mchod/ phyag bya/ bden stobs brjod/ grog mkhar bdun dang bsgrub bya'i rjes dang*/ bshang gci las liṅga sor brgyad pa byas la/ thod pa mtshan ngan kha sbyor steng ma la me'i dkyil 'khor raṃ gyis mtshan par phaṭa ch+gai+e mā ra ya phaṭa/ de'i rgyab tu ri rab/ steng du dbang chen rgya gram dang bcas pa/ 'og tu rlung la oṃ ch+gai a be sha ya aḥ.aḥ rgyab tu sna tshogs rdo rje bri/ liṅga'i snying gar hrīḥṣ+tīḥphaṭa ming rus ch+gai mā ra ya phaṭa/ de nas der liṅga 'khor lo'i bar du bcug /'khor lo man ngag bzhin dril/ ro skra'i srang bus dkris/ rgya gram gyis 'khor lo mi mthong bar du dkris/ g.yon skor 'og /g.yas skor steng*/

steng 'og ma log par bcug /dgug gzhug bya/ mi rus kyi phur pa gnas lngar brdeg /tshig rnams tsher mas dgang*/ drag po'i bsam gtan dang bcas pas thod par bcug la/ srad bus bsdams/ ga'u'i bu ga nas dug khrag yungs kar sogs thun blugs/ byin rlabs mchod bstod byas nas/ dur khrod kyi 'gal me'i me la so zhing sgrubs/ nyi ma bzhi pa 'dir sbyar la/ mthar de gshin rje'i gzugs kyi snying gar bcug la dur khrod du sba ba'ang dgos na bya'o/ /'dir las gzhan la k+ṣe brgyad ldan pa dang ma brgyad ldan pa la sogs pa'i sngags kyang 'ga' zhig 'dod do/ /las tshogs ni lag len la ltos pa ste dkyus 'dir mi 'dri'o/ /bar chad bsrung ba/ khro bo bcu'i bsrung zlog ni/ lā li ta'i gzhung du ri rab kyi rtser te dbus kyi khro bo rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum phyag drug par gyur pa de zhu bas chos 'byung du mdzad/ 'dir dbus kyi khro bo gnod mdzes 'og tu rdo rje sa 'og ces ming btags pa dang*/ gnod mdzes kyi phyag na rin chen lcags kyu pad+ma zhags pa bsnams pa ma gtogs 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs ji bzhin te/ 'gug gzhug rgyas btab sngags bzla ba rnams med do/ /'di la'ang man ngag gi phyir zlog 'ong bar mngon/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa zhes pa'i sgrub thabs su a mo gha chung bas gshed po zhal drug pa zhig la/ gshin rje brgyad kyis bskor ba'i srung zlog zhig kyang yod do/ / 'dir ni grub chen dpal 'dzin gyi phyir zlog drug pa ltar sgom na/ shū n+ya ya sogs/ chos 'byung du paṃ raṃ hūṃ las pad nyi sna tshogs rdo rje'i 'od zer las sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi sogs bsgom/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+ruṃ las/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa ser po/ lte bar nyi ma la rang sems hūṃ/ de las hūṃ bcu spros/ rtsibs bcur pad nyi la dbus kyi hūṃ rang nyid zhe sdang gshin rje gshed nag po rdo rje thod dbyug bsnams pa/

bdud bzhi brdzis pa'i ma he nag po la gnas pa/ shar du gshin rje gshed sogs rdo rje gur ltar bskyed/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dgug gzhug rgyas btab sogs sgrub thabs ltar bya/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros/ gnod byed rnams brdungs shing bkug la/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyis thal bar brlag par bsams/ phyir zlog byed na/ khro bo thams cad zhal phyir bstan/ zhabs g.yas brkyang rab tu khros pas/ pho nya mtha' yas pa spros te dgra bo thams cad rlag par mdzad cing*/ ji tsam bsrung 'dod pa de tsam du/ dgra bo'i lha la sogs pa bar chad byed pa rnams kyis mig gi ltar yang med parabasams la/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tīḥbi kri tā na na sarba sha trun nā sha ya staṃ bha ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ ya ma rā dza dang yi ge bcu pa bzlas la rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang mthun no/ /uṣ+ṇi ṣa rwa lugs zhes grags pa'i man ngag mchog de yang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi ma yin te/ gsang 'dus kho na yin pa'i phyir zhes smra ba ni mi legs te/ 'dus pa zhabs lugs kyi gdams ngag nyid la brten mod/ khro bo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa nyid kyis 'dus pa'i khro bo min par nges/ dpal 'dzin gyi 'di dang yang rjes su mthun pa dang gcig tu na rgyud kyi mthar thug 'dus pa ste zhes gshed skor gyi rgyud kun 'dus pa la mngon du phyogs pas na/ 'dus pa'i bsrung 'khor yang 'di la shin tu rung ste lā li tas mdzad pa bzhin no/ /des na phyir zlog rgyas pa ni uṣ+ṇi ṣa rwa lugs su shes par bya'o/ /de ltar na mchog gi dngos grub ni bsgrub bya'i gtso bo yin la/ de'i lam dngos ni rdzogs rim yin/ de'i yang sngon 'gro smin byed ni bskyed rim yin/ de la yang dbang thob cing dam tshig ldan pa dgos pa dang*/ dbang bskur yang dkyil 'khor sngon du 'gro ba dang*/ las dang dngos grub gyi sgrub pa thams cad la yang dkyil 'khor dgos so/

/ dbang po brtul pos bskyed rim brtan nas/ spyod pa spyad cing thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub nas/ las tshogs dang rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba'i don rgya cher spyod cing rdzogs rim bsgom mo/ /gang zag gsum kas sngags grub nas las tshogs thams cad kyis 'gro ba'i don sgrub pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin rgya chen pos kyang byed do/ /de yang snying rje chen po dang*/ bde chen byang chub kyi sems dang*/ 'khor gsum rang bzhin med par shes pa'i sgo nas/ lha sngags ting nge 'dzin gyis 'gro don sgrub pa 'di ni gzhan du bskal par 'gro phan spyod pa las kyang*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs ches lhag pa thabs kyi khyad par te/ de'i phyir las tshogs rgyal bas gsungs pa 'di dag /mu stegs byed rnams kyi las tshogs dang sngags rgyud rnams dang dgos pa 'dra bar ltar na/ de ltar mi rung ste sngags dang rgyud la 'phya ba ches sdig pa dang ldan pa'o/ /'dir las tshogs kyi dam tshig bstan pas gzhan rnams zur gyis bzung ngo*/ /de ltar shes nas las tshogs tsam la 'khyams pa dang*/ 'di dag drang don yin pas cir yang mi rung zhes ma gus pa'i nyes pa mi 'byung ngo*/ /de ltar na rgyud 'dir dbang bskur ba dam tshig thob la ma nyams pa/ rim pa gnyis la mtshan ma nye bar dmigs kyi bar du 'bad/ de nas thun mong sgrub pa brtsams/ de'i sgrub pa dang las la sbyar ba rtog pa dang po dang*/ nag po'i rgyud dang dmar po'i rgyud bzhin bya/ gal te mchog kho na 'dod na snga ma'i de nas rdzogs rim bde stong lhan skyes kyi rnam rol la gcig tu gril nas drod thob na/ spyod pa spyad pas mthar 'dod pa'i dngos grub ring por mi thogs par 'grub par 'gyur la/ thun mong 'don pas bskyed rim brtan nas/ thog mar spyod pa dang*/ de nas sgrub pa bya ba yin no/ /'dir dam tshig gi bris sku dang*/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las tshogs byed pa ni gang gis kyang ma rig par bya/

rgyud kyi tshul thams cad kyang snod min la gsang ba gal che bar gsungs/ yul mtshan nyid tshang nges pa la snying rjes ma gtogs drag las bkag /mchog dang bstan 'gro'i don du 'gyur des na dbang dgug byar rung gzhan du zhi rgyas kho na la 'bad/ rgyud 'dir grogs bzhi dang*/ bcas te sgrub pa gsungs pa'i grogs ni/ phyag rgya mo nus pa thob pa tsartsi kā sogs kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pa/ dam tshig gcig pa dag yin la/ bla ma rnams rnal 'byor pa nus pa thob pa bzhi yin par 'chad/ de lta bu rnyed dka' la/ gzhan gyis mthong na mi rung bas rang gcig pus sgrub pa yin no/ /de ltar na dngos grub rnam pa gnyis 'grub par nges pas/ skye bu'i lus ngag yid kyi nus mthu ci yod lam 'di la dril na/ dal 'byor don ldan par 'gyur te/ skye ba 'di nyid kyis sangs rgyas zhes bya ba yin no/ /'dir smras pa/ rtog ge'i yul las 'das gyur cing*/ /lha dang drang srong rnams rmongs pa'i/ /gnas 'dir rgyal pa rnams kyis mkhyain/ /sngags dang rgyud 'di rmad du byung*/ /rgyud rgyal rgyal ba'i spyod yul nyid lags shing*/ /blo rmongs rmongs pa'i dra bar chud gyur pas/ /sgrub thabs thabs tshul rgya che 'dir smras la/ / 'khrul tshe tshe rabs gzhan du sdig ma gyur/ /don mang don gsal tshig nyung nyung ngu'i dag /legs bshad legs par mang thos thos pa'i mdzod/ /rnam dpyod rnam par rgyas gang gang 'di la/ /zhib mos zhib spyod ngo mtshar mtshar ba yod/ /rgyud sde chu gter dpal ldan dngos grub mtshor/ /mtsho chen las blangs man ngag yid bzhin nor/ /nor mchog 'gro ba'i re skong phyogs las rgyal/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mor nam yang 'khor gyur cig /ces pa ni rgyal ba kun gyi yab mkhyen brtse'i gter thog ma med pa nas byang chub dam pa brnyes kyang thugs rjes rgyal ba thams cad kyi sras su sku bstan pas 'gro ba thams cad sgrol ba/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje khro bo rdo rje 'jigs byed ces bya ba bdag cag gi ston pa shākya'i rgyal po gdul dka' 'dul ba'i phyir rnam par mi rtog pa'i thugs rjes khros pa'i bcom ldan 'das kyi sgrub thabs nyung ngu la mos pa rjes su 'dzin pa rdo rje 'bar ba zhes pa 'di ni/

kun dga' snying po tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gnyis pa la sgrub gnas bsam gtan sdings su sbyar ba'o/ /bzhus/ /dirgā yuḥ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i sgrub thabs rdo rje 'bar ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 348 -- PAGE 347 -- PAGE 346 -
